mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% for two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary policy easing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform a random baseline in 60% of out-of-sample windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong underlying demand growth, which signals robust corporate earnings momentum and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 50% of triggered instances or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real economic output, which increases the probability of central bank intervention and triggers risk-on sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal generates negative returns in more than 60% of out-of-sample windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 235.0 combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate signals persistent inflationary pressure, which increases the likelihood of delayed rate cuts and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction signal fails to achieve Rank IC > 0.04 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 440,000 million dollars for two consecutive months, combined with a rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1), indicates strong aggregate demand expansion, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to generate positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of triggered instances or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 100,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months signals weakening labor market momentum, which increases the probability of future monetary easing and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform a random baseline in 60% of out-of-sample windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 for three consecutive months, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), indicates a broad-based economic contraction, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 105.0 for 3 consecutive months and UNRATE > 5.0%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction signal generates positive returns in more than 55% of out-of-sample windows.
